page.layout: One page of text, single column; a diagram (synopsis with braces) in the middle of the page between two sections of text; no notes in the margins.

main_text.p: œconomia, siue in administratione familiæ. Postrema subijciet respondentes his amicitiæ species. Summa autem horum hæc est.
Vnde etiam.) Probatio, quòd regno respondeat imperium patris in filios, ex authoritate Homeri.

Hoc quidem certè.) Rectum dicit esse ius domini in seruos. censet etenim, seruitutem talem iuris esse naturalis: quod & lege Mosaica uidemus comprobatum. Perficum autem illud ius alienum est à natura.
main_text.l: Aristocratia. — Respō det his: Viri in uxorem pro dignitate.
Timocratia. — Fratrum inter se pro dignitate.
Oligarchia. — Respō det his: Vir solus in omnib. dominus, uel mulier sola in omnibus.
main_text.head: CAPVT XI.
main_text.p: IN unoquoq; autem.) Iam accedit ad causam principalem, atq; declarat, sicut in unaquaque laudata specie Reipubl. est iustitia, ita inesse quoq;

page.notes: The Greek words in the synopsis are printed in Greek; the diagram lines are approximate in layout. Some Greek forms (Βασιλεία, Αριστοκρατία, Τιμοκρατία, Τυραννίς, Ολιγαρχία, Δημοκρατία) are read with uncertainty where the scan is faint.
